goal: Execute full MacLink development plan: Task 0 toolchain inspection, Task 1 Android release APK, Task 2 macOS release bundle/DMG, Task 3 build-all.sh automation, Task 4 test suites and clippy

steps.title: Task 0: Toolchain Inspection
steps.note: Task 0 Toolchain Inspection complete: rustc 1.98.1, Apple clang 21.0.0, OpenJDK 21.0.12.1, NDK 30.0.16248370, cargo-ndk 4.1.2, Qt 6.8.2. All doubts verified.

steps.title: Task 1: Android Release APK Build
steps.note: Task 1 Android release APK built: MacLink-0.0.1-android.apk (93 MB), dual-arch libmaclink_ffi.so (arm64-v8a + x86_64), 16KB page-aligned (0x4000), aapt package name in.maclink.srv, signed with v2 scheme verified.

steps.title: Task 2: macOS Release App and DMG Build
steps.note: Task 2 verified: maclink-desktop compiled in release mode, MacLink.app bundled with Qt 6.8.2 frameworks via macdeployqt, ad-hoc signed, codesign --verify --deep --strict passed, otool -L confirmed @rpath references, hdiutil verify confirmed valid DMG, and test launch verified process runs cleanly.

steps.title: Task 3: Unified Build Automation Script
steps.note: Task 3 verified: scripts/build-all.sh all executed cleanly, produced all target artifacts (MacLink.app, MacLink-0.0.1-macos-arm64.dmg, MacLink-0.0.1-macos-arm64.zip, MacLink-0.0.1-android.apk), generated SHA256SUMS.txt, and shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt verified OK for all files.

steps.title: Task 4: Tests and Clippy Verification
steps.note: Task 4 verified: 154 Rust tests passed across workspace (including all 80 two_devices integration tests), cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passed cleanly with zero warnings/errors, and 78 Android unit tests passed with BUILD SUCCESSFUL in testDebugUnitTest.
